entries.sentence: The Worker left this run's command unacknowledged, so the command bus delivers it again after a delay and the run continues from its last checkpoint.
entries.action: Nothing while it settles; if the same run repeats this line, read result_code and the lines before it.

entries.sentence: The Worker's output delivery settings are invalid, so this run's output could not be prepared.
entries.action: Check the Worker's output and spool settings, then restart the Worker.

entries.sentence: This run's saved output failed the Worker's validation, so it was not sent.
entries.action: Report the support reference to the platform team; the run's saved output is kept for inspection.

entries.sentence: The Worker's output spool is full, so this run's output could not be saved.
entries.action: Check the spool volume's free space and the Worker's spool limits.

entries.sentence: The Worker could not read or write its output spool, so this run's output waits and is tried again.
entries.action: Check the spool volume; the Worker retries within the run's lease.

entries.sentence: Main's output service did not answer, so this run's output waits and is sent again.
entries.action: Check Main's runtime listener; the Worker retries within the run's lease.

entries.sentence: The Worker's progress publication settings are invalid, so this run's progress updates are not sent.
entries.action: Check the Worker's output session limit, then restart the Worker.

entries.sentence: A progress update did not match this run's state, so it was not sent.
entries.action: Report the support reference to the platform team.

entries.sentence: Main refused this run's progress update, so the turn will be recovered from its last checkpoint.
entries.action: Read the cause; if Main keeps refusing updates for new runs, check the Worker and Main versions.

entries.sentence: Main's output service did not answer a progress update, so the update is kept and sent again.
entries.action: Check Main's runtime listener; the Worker reconnects on its own.

entries.sentence: A fan-out node with Code items was refused before it started because its items cannot finish before the run's deadline.
entries.action: Nothing on the platform; the user lowers the item count or raises the node's concurrency, or the run is given more time.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt was refused before it started because the run's remaining time is shorter than the Code timeout plus the observation margin.
entries.action: Nothing when the run was near its end; when cause is slot_wait, the Worker was full, so raise code_slots together with the Supervisor's concurrency.

entries.sentence: A Code item of a Map or Parallel was interrupted after it may have started and no owner proof showed its effect, so it ended typed and was not run again.
entries.action: Find the item by its support_ref in the run's failed join entry and check the target system for its effect; the run's other items are unaffected.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt that already held a Code slot asked for a second one, so it was refused at once instead of waiting for a slot it holds itself.
entries.action: Report it with the support reference: a code path acquires a Code slot inside another Code attempt, which must not happen.

entries.sentence: A Code attempt waited more than a second for a slot because this Worker was already running as many Code attempts on that Supervisor as its code_slots allow.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; if it repeats, raise code_slots together with the Supervisor's concurrency.

entries.sentence: The sandbox Supervisor answered busy to a Code attempt, so the attempt keeps its slot and retries with backoff until the Supervisor has room.
entries.action: Nothing when it is rare; if it repeats, more Worker slots share the Supervisor than its concurrency allows, so lower code_slots or raise the concurrency.
